name: Sleep Log
description: Tap when you go to bed and when you wake up. See your hours, how you slept, your usual bedtime and a 14-night chart.
prompt: A sleep tracker with a going to sleep and I am awake button, manual entries with bed and wake times, a quality emoji and notes, a 14-night bar chart with the goal line, the 7-day average, usual bedtime, best night and a daily sleep tip.
author: gonzaroman
